channel.title: AI GridWatch — Maine data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Maine, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Eastport: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium adopted unanimously targeting DeepGreen underwater data center proposal

item.title: Bangor: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day pause, 9-0. City cited lack of information about infrastructure impacts and no state-level framework to reference

item.title: Sanford: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 91-day emergency moratorium enacted May 19, 2026, halting a proposed Mousam River data center project; extended unanimously for 180 more days on Aug 5, 2026.

item.title: Maine (statewide): data center moratorium — Vetoed
item.description: LD 307 would have paused 20+ MW facilities to Nov 2027; governor vetoed
